h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Karimnagar

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Karimnagar

items.pText: Karimnagar, in northern Telangana on the Manair river, is known for its granite quarries and its silver filigree work. Granite is everywhere in the town, including the paving of many school courtyards, society gardens and parks. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment for these sites from our factory in Vasai, about 660 km away, delivered by road.

Stone paving looks neat and needs little upkeep, but it is one of the hardest surfaces a child can fall on. Some older play areas in the region have swings and slides set straight onto granite or tiles. If yours is one of them, the paving may not need to come up at all. Rubber flooring can often be laid over a sound, level paved surface, with the equipment self-standing on its base or fixed in the way the site needs.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Adding rubber flooring over stone or tiles

c: Check first that the paving is level and firmly bedded, since loose or broken slabs will show through the flooring. Mark the safe play area of each piece and cover that whole zone, not only the spot directly under a slide. Finish the edges neatly so there is no lip for children to trip on where flooring meets stone. Keep a slope for rainwater so it does not pool under the mats in the monsoon. Telangana's summer sun is strong, so plan shade over dark flooring.

facts.label: Delivery and installation

items.q: Is granite paving safe under playground equipment?
items.a: Granite is very hard and gives no cushioning in a fall. We suggest rubber flooring over the safe play area of each piece, laid on the existing paving if it is sound and level.

items.q: Can rubber flooring be laid over existing tiles?
items.a: Usually, yes, if the tiles are firm and level. Loose or broken tiles should be fixed first, and the edges need a neat finish so children do not trip where flooring meets stone.
Yes. We send equipment from our Vasai factory to Karimnagar by road and can supply rubber flooring with the same order. Our installation team or a dealer in Telangana installs everything.
